logic.benchmark: Static 50/50 initial BTC/ETH capital, buy once at the initial 00:01 UTC reference and hold until terminal costed liquidation. No interim rebalancing, leverage, cash yield or transfers.
logic.execution: At 2025-09-19T00:01:00Z buy each independent 1,000 USDT sleeve once, then costed terminal exits at 2026-09-14T00:01:00Z. No interim trades.
logic.costs: Each partial rebalance applies fee, estimated half-spread, slippage, square-root impact, exchange tick/lot/notional and percent-price filters; order participation is capped at 0.1% of lagged 20-day quote ADV. Cost assumptions scale by 1x/2x/3x. Below-minimum legal orders are skipped and recorded, not imputed.
